select * from hr_employee s, sys_department d, sys_post p where s.depart_id = d.id and s.post_id = p.id
limit #{startIndex}, #{pageSize}

select s.*, d.dname, p.pname, DATE_FORMAT(s.birthday,'%Y-%m-%d') as birthday1, DATE_FORMAT(s.entrydate,'%Y-%m-%d') as entrydate1, DATE_FORMAT(s.joinworkdate,'%Y-%m-%d') as joinworkdate1, DATE_FORMAT(s.graduationdate,'%Y-%m-%d') as graduationdate1, DATE_FORMAT(s.startdate,'%Y-%m-%d') as startdate1, DATE_FORMAT(s.enddate,'%Y-%m-%d') as enddate1 from hr_employee s left join sys_department d on s.depart_id = d.id left join sys_post p on s.post_id = p.id where s.id = #{id};

select s.id, s.sname, s.sex, s.birthday, s.sid, s.depart_id, s.post_id, s.entrydate, s.joinworkdate, s.workform, s.staffsource, s.politicalstatus, s.nation, s.nativeplace, s.stel, s.semail, s.skill_tags, s.sheight, s.bloodtype, s.maritalstatus, s.registeredresidence, s.education, s.degree, s.university, s.major, s.graduationdate, s.startdate, s.enddate, s.peroidopdate, COALESCE(s.status, '正常') as status, s.user_id, d.dname, p.pname, DATE_FORMAT(s.startdate,'%Y-%m-%d') as startdate1, DATE_FORMAT(s.enddate,'%Y-%m-%d') as enddate1 from hr_employee s left join sys_department d on s.depart_id = d.id left join sys_post p on s.post_id = p.id where (s.startdate IS NOT NULL or s.enddate IS NOT NULL) or (s.status IS NOT NULL and s.status != '正常')
limit #{startIndex}, #{pageSize}
SELECT DISTINCT q.id, t.id from quit q, transfer t where q.staff_id = #{id} or t.staff_id = #{id}
select s.sname as sname, COALESCE(s.post_id, 0) as beforepost_id, COALESCE(p.pname, '未分配岗位') as beforepost_name from hr_employee s left join sys_post p on s.post_id = p.id where s.id = #{id}

select t.id, t.staff_id, t.sname, t.ttype, t.beforepost_id, t.afterpost_id, COALESCE(bp.pname, '未知岗位') as beforepost_name, COALESCE(ap.pname, '未知岗位') as afterpost_name, DATE_FORMAT(t.tdate,'%Y-%m-%d') as tdate1, DATE_FORMAT(t.opdate,'%Y-%m-%d') as opdate1 from transfer t left join sys_post bp on t.beforepost_id = bp.id left join sys_post ap on t.afterpost_id = ap.id order by t.tdate desc, t.opdate desc
limit #{startIndex}, #{pageSize}
